en: The Kingdom of Hungary as a Central European monarchy existing from 1000 to 1946
Its emergence from the Grand Principality of Hungary at the coronation of Stephen I around 1000
Rule by Stephen's Arpad dynasty for 300 years
Its rise to the rank of a European power by the twelfth century
zh: 匈牙利王国是1000至1946年间中欧的君主国
约1000年斯蒂芬一世加冕，由匈牙利大公国延续而来
阿尔帕德王朝统治三百年
12世纪成为欧洲强国

politics.zh: 匈牙利王国是中欧的君主国，自1000年斯蒂芬一世在埃斯泰尔戈姆加冕起延续近千年，至1946年废除君主制。天主教王国由匈牙利大公国延续而来，斯蒂芬一世的阿尔帕德王朝统治约三百年。12世纪王国已成为欧洲强国，此后经历安茹、卢森堡与哈布斯堡等王朝，1526年摩哈赤战败后国土分为三部分，哈布斯堡一方延续王国名号至20世纪。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Hungary was a monarchy in Central Europe that existed for nearly a millennium, from 1000 to 1946. The Catholic kingdom emerged as a continuation of the Grand Principality of Hungary upon the coronation of Stephen I at Esztergom around 1000, and his Arpad dynasty led the monarchy for three hundred years. By the twelfth century it had become a European power, and after the defeat at Mohacs in 1526 its lands were divided in three, the Habsburg part carrying the royal title into the twentieth century.

economy.zh: 王国经济以多瑙河中游的农业、矿业与畜牧业为基础，中世纪盛产金银与盐，特兰西瓦尼亚与上匈牙利的矿城为王室提供重要收入，牲畜与葡萄酒是主要出口品。
economy.en: The kingdom's economy rested on farming, mining and herding in the middle Danube basin; gold, silver and salt were produced in the Middle Ages, the mining towns of Transylvania and Upper Hungary supplied important royal revenue, and cattle and wine were the main exports.

culture.zh: 匈牙利王国在11世纪皈依天主教后成为中西欧文化与东正教、游牧传统之间的接触地带，拉丁语长期是行政语言，布达与佩斯在14世纪后成为宫廷与学术中心，马加什一世的图书馆闻名欧洲。
culture.en: After its conversion to Catholicism in the eleventh century the kingdom became a meeting place of western and central European culture with Orthodox and nomadic traditions; Latin long served as the language of administration, Buda and Pest became centres of court and learning after the fourteenth century, and the library of Matthias Corvinus was famous in Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约1000年斯蒂芬一世加冕、1241至1242年蒙古入侵、1456年贝尔格莱德保卫战、1526年摩哈赤战败，以及1541年后国土三分。
events.en: Key moments are the coronation of Stephen I around 1000, the Mongol invasion of 1241-1242, the defence of Belgrade in 1456, the defeat at Mohacs in 1526 and the division of the kingdom after 1541.

value.zh: 约1000年斯蒂芬一世加冕，王国建立。
value.en: It was founded with the coronation of Stephen I around 1000.

value.zh: 阿尔帕德王朝统治约三百年。
value.en: The Arpad dynasty ruled for about three hundred years.

en: The Kingdom of Poland as a state in Central Europe during the medieval and early modern periods
Its existence from 1025 until 1795
zh: 波兰王国是中世纪与近代早期中欧的国家
自1025年延续至1795年

politics.zh: 波兰王国是中世纪与近代早期中欧的国家，自1025年博莱斯瓦夫一世加冕起延续至1795年第三次瓜分。它由皮雅斯特王朝建立，14世纪与立陶宛联合后形成波兰-立陶宛联邦，实行选举君主制与议会制度，18世纪在俄、普、奥三次瓜分中亡国。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Poland was a state in Central Europe during the medieval and early modern periods, existing from 1025, when Boleslaw I was crowned, until the third partition of 1795. Founded by the Piast dynasty, it entered a union with Lithuania in the fourteenth century that became the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, an elective monarchy with a strong parliament, and it disappeared in the three partitions carried out by Russia, Prussia and Austria in the eighteenth century.

economy.zh: 王国经济以维斯瓦河流域的农业为基础，谷物经格但斯克出口西欧，16世纪后庄园经济与农奴制强化，克拉科夫与华沙是商业与手工业中心。
economy.en: The kingdom's economy rested on farming in the Vistula basin, with grain exported to western Europe through Danzig; after the sixteenth century estate agriculture and serfdom grew stronger, and Krakow and Warsaw were centres of commerce and craft.

culture.zh: 波兰王国在14世纪建立克拉科夫大学，文艺复兴与宗教改革时期文学与科学繁荣，拉丁语与波兰语并用，天主教会在文化生活中居核心地位。
culture.en: The kingdom founded the University of Krakow in the fourteenth century, literature and science flourished in the Renaissance and Reformation, Latin and Polish were used side by side, and the Catholic Church held a central place in cultural life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1025年加冕建王国、1385年与立陶宛联合、1569年卢布林合并、17世纪的战争与衰落，以及1772至1795年三次瓜分。
events.en: Key moments are the coronation and founding of the kingdom in 1025, the union with Lithuania in 1385, the Union of Lublin in 1569, the wars and decline of the seventeenth century and the three partitions between 1772 and 1795.

value.zh: 自1025年延续至1795年。
value.en: It existed from 1025 until 1795.

value.zh: 14世纪与立陶宛联合，后形成波兰-立陶宛联邦。
value.en: It united with Lithuania in the fourteenth century, later forming the Commonwealth.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 英文条目导言只给出该王国的时段，本篇按导言与目录记录可支持的范围撰写，未补入导言之外的细节；中文维基同名条目属于另一实体，未引为来源。
entries.scopeNoteEn: The English introduction gives only the period of the kingdom, so the essay stays within what it supports; the Chinese article of this name documents another entity and is not cited.

en: Moldavia as a historical region and former principality in Eastern Europe between the Eastern Carpathians and the Dniester
Its existence from the fourteenth century, initially independent and later autonomous under Ottoman overlordship
zh: 摩尔达维亚是东欧喀尔巴阡山东麓与德涅斯特河之间的历史地区与旧公国
14世纪起存在，先独立后为奥斯曼宗主权下的自治公国

politics.zh: 摩尔达维亚公国是东欧的历史地区与前公国，地域相当于东喀尔巴阡山与德涅斯特河之间的地带，14世纪建国，最初独立，后成为奥斯曼帝国宗主权下的自治公国，由大公（ Hospodar）统治。它与瓦拉几亚同为罗马尼亚人的两个多瑙河公国，1859年两公国联合，奠定了现代罗马尼亚的基础。
politics.en: Moldavia is a historical region and former principality in Eastern Europe corresponding to the territory between the Eastern Carpathians and the Dniester. It existed from the fourteenth century, at first independent and later autonomous under Ottoman overlordship, ruled by a prince or hospodar. Together with Wallachia it was one of the two Danubian principalities of the Romanians, and in 1859 the two united, laying the foundation of modern Romania.

economy.zh: 公国经济以农业与畜牧业为主，谷物、牲畜与蜂蜜、蜡是主要出口品，多瑙河与德涅斯特河口岸连接黑海贸易，山林与盐矿提供补充收入。
economy.en: The principality's economy centred on farming and herding, with grain, livestock, honey and wax as the main exports, the Danube and Dniester ports linking it to Black Sea trade, and forests and salt mines providing further income.

culture.zh: 摩尔达维亚使用罗马尼亚语与教会斯拉夫语，东正教修道院是文化与书籍抄写的中心，15至16世纪的彩绘教堂与编年史是重要遗产。
culture.en: Romanian and Church Slavonic were used in Moldavia, Orthodox monasteries were centres of culture and manuscript copying, and the painted churches and chronicles of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries are important legacies. Its painted monasteries are still visited today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪建国、15世纪斯特凡大公时期的抵抗、16世纪起承认奥斯曼宗主权、18世纪俄国与奥斯曼的争夺，以及1859年与瓦拉几亚联合。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the fourteenth century, the resistance under Stephen the Great in the fifteenth, the acceptance of Ottoman suzerainty from the sixteenth century, the Russian-Ottoman contests of the eighteenth and the union with Wallachia in 1859.

value.zh: 位于东喀尔巴阡山与德涅斯特河之间。
value.en: It lay between the Eastern Carpathians and the Dniester.

value.zh: 1859年与瓦拉几亚联合。
value.en: It united with Wallachia in 1859.

en: Anglo-Saxon England as the period from the end of Roman rule in Britain in the fifth century until the Norman Conquest of 1066
Its territory reaching north to present-day Lothian in south-eastern Scotland
Its initial exclusion of western areas such as Cornwall and Herefordshire
zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰指5世纪罗马统治结束至1066年诺曼征服之间的时期
领土北至今苏格兰东南部的洛锡安
最初不包括康沃尔、赫里福德郡等西部地带

politics.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰指5世纪罗马在不列颠统治结束至1066年诺曼征服之间的时期。与今日英格兰相比，其领土北至今苏格兰东南部的洛锡安，而最初并不包括康沃尔、赫里福德郡与什罗普郡等西部地带。这一时期先后出现多个王国，7世纪后形成麦西亚、韦塞克斯与诺森布里亚等强权，10世纪在韦塞克斯王室下走向统一。
politics.en: Anglo-Saxon England covers the period from the end of Roman rule in Britain in the fifth century until the Norman Conquest of 1066. Compared with modern England its territory reached north to present-day Lothian in south-eastern Scotland, while it did not initially include western areas such as Cornwall, Herefordshire and Shropshire. Several kingdoms emerged, with Mercia, Wessex and Northumbria dominant after the seventh century, and unification came under the West Saxon royal house in the tenth.

economy.zh: 经济以农业为基础，村镇与王室庄园构成生产单位，手工业生产与贸易城镇在7世纪后兴起，英格兰的银币与羊毛、奴隶出口见于欧陆记载。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, with villages and royal estates as the units of production; craft production and trading towns emerged after the seventh century, and English silver coinage along with exports of wool and slaves appear in continental records.

culture.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊时期确立了古英语文学与法律传统，《贝奥武夫》与《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》是代表作，修道院是学术中心，10世纪起本笃会改革推动教育与手抄本艺术。
culture.en: The Anglo-Saxon period established Old English literature and law: Beowulf and the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle are its landmarks, monasteries were centres of learning, and the Benedictine reform from the tenth century advanced education and manuscript art.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪日耳曼人定居、7世纪基督教化、9世纪维京入侵与阿尔弗雷德大帝的抵抗、10世纪统一，以及1066年诺曼征服。
events.en: Key moments are the Germanic settlement of the fifth century, Christianisation in the seventh, the Viking invasions of the ninth and Alfred the Great's resistance, the unification of the tenth century and the Norman Conquest of 1066.

value.zh: 自5世纪罗马统治结束至1066年诺曼征服。
value.en: It runs from the end of Roman rule in the fifth century to the Norman Conquest of 1066.

value.zh: 北至洛锡安，最初不含西部部分地区。
value.en: It reached north to Lothian and initially excluded some western areas.

en: The Kingdom of Bohemia as a medieval and early modern monarchy in Central Europe and predecessor of the modern Czech Republic
Its status as an Imperial State of the Holy Roman Empire
The Bohemian king as a prince-elector of the empire
zh: 波希米亚王国是中欧中世纪与近代早期的君主国，也是现代捷克共和国的前身
是神圣罗马帝国的帝国邦国
波希米亚国王为帝国选帝侯

politics.zh: 波希米亚王国是中欧中世纪与近代早期的君主国，也是现代捷克共和国的前身。它是神圣罗马帝国的帝国邦国，国王为帝国七大选帝侯之一，首都布拉格在14世纪查理四世时期成为帝国宫廷所在地。15世纪胡斯战争后王国经历宗教与政治动荡，1526年起由哈布斯堡家族统治，1620年白山战役后丧失独立地位。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Bohemia was a medieval and early modern monarchy in Central Europe and the predecessor state of the modern Czech Republic. It was an Imperial State of the Holy Roman Empire and its king was one of the empire's prince-electors, with Prague serving as the imperial seat under Charles IV in the fourteenth century. The Hussite wars of the fifteenth century brought religious and political upheaval, the Habsburgs took the throne in 1526, and the Battle of the White Mountain in 1620 ended its independence.

economy.zh: 王国经济以易北河与伏尔塔瓦河流域的农业、银矿与手工业为基础，库特纳霍拉的银矿是中欧重要财源，布拉格是贸易与手工业中心。
economy.en: The kingdom's economy rested on farming in the Elbe and Vltava basins, on silver mining and on crafts; the silver mines of Kutna Hora were a major source of revenue in central Europe, and Prague was a centre of trade and manufacture.

culture.zh: 波希米亚在14世纪建立布拉格大学，捷克语文学与宗教改革思想在此兴起，胡斯运动推动民族语言与教会改革，布拉格城堡与圣维特教堂是建筑遗产的代表。
culture.en: Bohemia founded the University of Prague in the fourteenth century, Czech literature and reformist religious thought emerged there, the Hussite movement advanced the vernacular and church reform, and Prague Castle and St Vitus Cathedral are landmarks of its architecture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1198年获得王号、1348年建立布拉格大学、1419至1434年胡斯战争、1526年哈布斯堡入主，以及1620年白山战役。
events.en: Key moments are the grant of the royal title in 1198, the founding of the University of Prague in 1348, the Hussite wars of 1419-1434, the accession of the Habsburgs in 1526 and the Battle of the White Mountain in 1620.

value.zh: 波希米亚国王是神圣罗马帝国选帝侯之一。
value.en: The king of Bohemia was a prince-elector of the Holy Roman Empire.

value.zh: 1526年起由哈布斯堡家族统治。
value.en: The Habsburgs held the throne from 1526.

en: The Electorate of Saxony as an Electorate of the Holy Roman Empire from 1356 to 1806
Its centre in the Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg with its capital at Dresden
Its rulers from the House of Ascania until 1422 and then the House of Wettin until 1806
Its replacement by the Kingdom of Saxony
zh: 萨克森选侯国是1356至1806年神圣罗马帝国的选侯国
以萨克森-维滕贝格公国为中心，首都德累斯顿
1422年前由阿斯卡尼亚家族统治，此后由韦廷家族统治至1806年
后由萨克森王国取代

politics.zh: 萨克森选侯国是1356至1806年间神圣罗马帝国的选侯国，以萨克森-维滕贝格公国为中心，首都设在德累斯顿，是帝国内最重要的邦国之一。其统治者正式称号为萨克森选帝侯，1422年前出自阿斯卡尼亚家族，此后由韦廷家族世袭，1806年帝国解体后改为萨克森王国。
politics.en: The Electorate of Saxony was an Electorate of the Holy Roman Empire from 1356 to 1806, centred on the Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg with its capital at Dresden and counted among the empire's most significant states. Its rulers were formally Prince-Electors of Saxony, coming from the House of Ascania until 1422 and then from the House of Wettin until 1806, when the electorate was replaced by the Kingdom of Saxony.

economy.zh: 选侯国地处易北河中游，农业与矿业是经济基础，厄尔士山区的银矿与后来的瓷土开采带来财富，德累斯顿与莱比锡是贸易与出版中心。
economy.en: The electorate lay on the middle Elbe, where farming and mining formed the economic base; silver from the Ore Mountains and later clay for porcelain brought wealth, and Dresden and Leipzig were centres of trade and publishing.

culture.zh: 萨克森选侯国是宗教改革的发源地，1517年马丁·路德在维滕贝格发表论纲，此后宫廷赞助音乐与艺术，德累斯顿在18世纪成为重要的巴洛克城市。
culture.en: The electorate was the birthplace of the Reformation, where Martin Luther published his theses at Wittenberg in 1517, and its court later patronised music and the arts, with Dresden becoming an important Baroque city in the eighteenth century.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1356年金玺诏书确认选侯地位、1517年宗教改革开始、16世纪韦廷家族的分支与合并，以及1806年改为萨克森王国。
events.en: Key moments are the confirmation of electoral status by the Golden Bull of 1356, the beginning of the Reformation in 1517, the divisions and reunions of the Wettin line in the sixteenth century and the change to a kingdom in 1806.

value.zh: 1356年金玺诏书确认其选侯地位。
value.en: Its electoral status was confirmed by the Golden Bull of 1356.

value.zh: 1517年路德在维滕贝格发表论纲。
value.en: Luther published his theses at Wittenberg in 1517.

en: The Kingdom of the West Saxons, or Wessex, as an Anglo-Saxon kingdom in southern Great Britain from about 519 to about 927
Alfred the Great's adoption of the title King of the Anglo-Saxons around 886
The conquest of the Danish kingdoms by Alfred's son Edward the Elder and grandson Aethelstan
zh: 韦塞克斯王国是约519至927年大不列颠南部的盎格鲁-撒克逊王国
约886年阿尔弗雷德大帝采用盎格鲁-撒克逊人之王的称号
其子爱德华长者与其孙埃塞尔斯坦征服丹麦法区诸王国

politics.zh: 韦塞克斯王国又称西撒克逊王国，是约519年至927年间大不列颠南部的盎格鲁-撒克逊王国。约886年，阿尔弗雷德大帝采用盎格鲁-撒克逊人之王的称号，成为不在丹麦人统治下的所有盎格鲁-撒克逊人的统治者；此后三十年间，其子爱德华长者与孙埃塞尔斯坦征服丹麦法区诸王国，为英格兰的统一奠定基础，927年韦塞克斯王室成为全英格兰的统治者。
politics.en: The Kingdom of the West Saxons, also known as Wessex, was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom in the south of Great Britain from around 519 to around 927. In about 886 Alfred the Great adopted the title King of the Anglo-Saxons as ruler of all Anglo-Saxons not under Danish rule, and over the following thirty years his son Edward the Elder and grandson Aethelstan conquered the Danish kingdoms, laying the foundation of a unified England, so that by 927 the West Saxon house ruled all of it.

economy.zh: 韦塞克斯以南部丘陵的农业、王室庄园与贸易城镇为基础，南安普敦与伦敦等港口联系欧陆，10世纪起银币铸造与市镇网络逐步扩展。
economy.en: Wessex rested on farming in the southern downlands, on royal estates and on trading towns, with ports such as Southampton and London linking it to the continent, and from the tenth century coinage and the network of towns expanded.

culture.zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝推动教育与翻译，邀请学者到宫廷，组织编纂《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》，韦塞克斯由此成为古英语文学与王国治理文献的中心。
culture.en: Alfred promoted education and translation, brought scholars to his court and sponsored the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, so that Wessex became the centre of Old English literature and of writing on royal government. Its court attracted scholars from across Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约519年立国、871年阿尔弗雷德即位、878年埃丁顿战役、886年采用新王号，以及927年埃塞尔斯坦统一英格兰。
events.en: Key moments are the founding around 519, Alfred's accession in 871, the battle of Edington in 878, the new royal title of about 886 and the unification of England under Aethelstan in 927. Wessex gave its name to the later English kingdom.

value.zh: 约886年阿尔弗雷德采用盎格鲁-撒克逊人之王的称号。
value.en: In about 886 Alfred took the title King of the Anglo-Saxons.

value.zh: 927年其王室统治全英格兰。
value.en: By 927 his house ruled all of England.

en: Mercia as an early medieval Anglo-Saxon kingdom, one of the seven of the Anglo-Saxon period
Its centre on the River Trent and its tributaries, in what is now the Midlands of England
Its royal court moving around the kingdom without a fixed capital
Repton as the site of an important early royal estate
zh: 默西亚是盎格鲁-撒克逊七国之一的中世纪早期王国
中心在特伦特河及其支流流域，即今英格兰中部
王廷没有固定首都，随国王巡行
雷普顿早期是重要的王室庄园所在地

politics.zh: 默西亚是盎格鲁-撒克逊时期七国之一的中世纪早期王国，中心位于特伦特河及其支流流域，即今英格兰中部地区。王廷没有固定的首都，随国王在各地巡行，早期的雷普顿是重要的王室庄园所在。8世纪埃塞尔巴德与奥法时期默西亚称霸英格兰南部，9世纪后在维京入侵与韦塞克斯崛起的双重压力下失去主导地位。
politics.en: Mercia was an early medieval Anglo-Saxon kingdom, one of the seven of the Anglo-Saxon period, centred on the River Trent and its tributaries in what is now the Midlands of England. The royal court moved around the kingdom without a fixed capital, and Repton seems early on to have been the site of an important royal estate. In the eighth century, under Aethelbald and Offa, Mercia dominated southern England, and after the ninth century it lost its leading position under Viking invasion and the rise of Wessex.

economy.zh: 默西亚经济以农业与王室庄园为基础，特伦特河与塞文河提供运输通道，伦敦与切斯特等地的贸易路线经过其境，手工业与市镇在8世纪后发展。
economy.en: Mercia's economy rested on farming and royal estates, the Trent and Severn provided transport, trade routes through London and Chester crossed its territory, and crafts and towns developed after the eighth century. Its mints produced some of the finest coins of the period.

culture.zh: 奥法时期修建的奥法堤界定了与威尔士的边界，成为重要的地面遗迹；默西亚的修道院如雷普顿与布里登斯通是宗教与学术中心，金币与银币显示其与欧陆的联系。
culture.en: Offa's Dyke, built in his reign, marked the border with Wales and remains a major earthwork; Mercian monasteries such as Repton and Breedon were centres of religion and learning, and its gold and silver coins show its links with the continent.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6至7世纪立国、8世纪奥法时期的霸权、9世纪维京入侵与丹麦法区的建立，以及10世纪并入统一的英格兰。
events.en: Key moments are its foundation in the sixth and seventh centuries, the hegemony of Offa in the eighth, the Viking invasions and the creation of the Danelaw in the ninth and its absorption into a unified England in the tenth.

value.zh: 王廷没有固定首都，随国王巡行。
value.en: The royal court moved about the kingdom without a fixed capital.

value.zh: 奥法时期修建奥法堤，界定与威尔士的边界。
value.en: Offa's Dyke, built in Offa's reign, marked the Welsh border.

en: The Crown of Aragon as a composite monarchy ruled by one king, originating in the dynastic union of the Kingdom of Aragon and the County of Barcelona
Its end as a consequence of the War of the Spanish Succession
Its height in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries as a thalassocracy controlling much of the western Mediterranean
zh: 阿拉贡联合王国是由一位国王统治的复合君主国，起源于阿拉贡王国与巴塞罗那伯国的王朝联合
因西班牙王位继承战争而终结
14至15世纪鼎盛，是控制西地中海大部的海权

politics.zh: 阿拉贡联合王国是由一位国王统治的复合君主国，起源于阿拉贡王国与巴塞罗那伯国（后来的加泰罗尼亚公国）的王朝联合。14至15世纪鼎盛时期，它是控制西地中海大片海域的海权国家，辖有阿拉贡、加泰罗尼亚、瓦伦西亚、巴利阿里群岛以及西西里、撒丁与那不勒斯等地，各构成国保留自己的法律与议会，西班牙王位继承战争后终结。
politics.en: The Crown of Aragon was a composite monarchy ruled by a single king, originating in the dynastic union of the Kingdom of Aragon and the County of Barcelona, later the Principality of Catalonia. At its height in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it was a thalassocracy controlling much of the western Mediterranean, holding Aragon, Catalonia, Valencia and the Balearics together with Sicily, Sardinia and Naples, while each constituent realm kept its own law and parliament; it ended as a consequence of the War of the Spanish Succession.

economy.zh: 经济以地中海的航运与贸易为核心，巴塞罗那与瓦伦西亚是重要港口，加泰罗尼亚的纺织业、西西里的谷物与撒丁的盐构成交换网络， consul 制度保护海外商人。
economy.en: The economy centred on Mediterranean shipping and trade, with Barcelona and Valencia as major ports; Catalan textiles, Sicilian grain and Sardinian salt formed a network of exchange, and consulates protected merchants abroad. Its merchants were active from Alexandria to Bruges.

culture.zh: 联合王国各构成国语言与制度并存，加泰罗尼亚语、阿拉贡语与拉丁语并用，巴塞罗那的哥特式建筑与瓦伦西亚的文学在15世纪达到高峰。
culture.en: The constituent realms kept their own languages and institutions, with Catalan, Aragonese and Latin in use together, and the Gothic architecture of Barcelona and Valencian literature reached their height in the fifteenth century. Its archives and law codes survive in Barcelona and Valencia.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1137年王朝联合、13世纪征服瓦伦西亚与巴利阿里、14至15世纪的地中海扩张、1469年与卡斯蒂利亚联姻，以及1707至1716年王位继承战争后的解体。
events.en: Key moments are the dynastic union of 1137, the conquest of Valencia and the Balearics in the thirteenth century, Mediterranean expansion in the fourteenth and fifteenth, the marriage with Castile in 1469 and the dissolution that followed the War of the Spanish Succession between 1707 and 1716.

value.zh: 起源于1137年阿拉贡与巴塞罗那伯国的王朝联合。
value.en: It originated in the 1137 dynastic union of Aragon and the County of Barcelona.

value.zh: 因西班牙王位继承战争而终结。
value.en: It ended as a consequence of the War of the Spanish Succession.

en: The First Bulgarian Empire as a medieval state in south-eastern and southeastern Central Europe between the seventh and eleventh centuries
Its foundation in 680-681 after Bulgars led by Asparuh moved south to the north-eastern Balkans
Byzantine recognition of their right to settle south of the Danube after their victory
zh: 保加利亚第一帝国是7至11世纪东南欧与中欧东南部的中世纪国家
680至681年阿斯帕鲁赫率保加尔人南下巴尔干东北部后建立
战胜拜占庭后获得其承认，得以在多瑙河以南定居

politics.zh: 保加利亚第一帝国是7至11世纪间存在于东南欧与中欧东南部的中世纪国家。680至681年，阿斯帕鲁赫率领的保加尔人南下至巴尔干东北部，击败拜占庭军队后获得其承认，取得在多瑙河以南定居的权利，当地南斯拉夫部落也参与其中。帝国在9世纪鲍里斯一世时期皈依基督教，西美昂一世时期达到鼎盛，1018年为拜占庭所灭。
politics.en: The First Bulgarian Empire was a medieval state in south-eastern and southeastern Central Europe between the seventh and eleventh centuries. It was founded in 680-681 after a group of Bulgars led by Asparuh moved south to the north-eastern Balkans and, having defeated the Byzantines, secured recognition and the right to settle south of the Danube, with local South Slavic tribes taking part. The empire adopted Christianity under Boris I in the ninth century, reached its height under Simeon I and was destroyed by Byzantium in 1018.

economy.zh: 经济以多瑙河平原的农业、畜牧与手工业为基础，普雷斯拉夫与普利斯卡是政治与商业中心，与拜占庭、基辅罗斯及亚得里亚海沿岸的贸易带来收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding and crafts in the Danubian plain, with Preslav and Pliska as centres of government and commerce, and trade with Byzantium, Kievan Rus and the Adriatic coast brought revenue. Its position on the Danube made it a hub of regional trade.

culture.zh: 保加利亚是第一斯拉夫文字与文学的中心之一，9世纪末格拉哥里字母与西里尔字母在此发展，普雷斯拉夫文学流派与金器艺术代表其文化成就。
culture.en: Bulgaria was one of the centres of the first Slavic script and literature, with Glagolitic and Cyrillic developing there at the end of the ninth century, and the Preslav literary school and goldsmithing representing its cultural achievement.

events.zh: 关键节点包括681年建国、864年皈依基督教、893至927年西美昂一世时期的鼎盛，以及1018年被拜占庭吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in 681, the adoption of Christianity in 864, the height under Simeon I from 893 to 927 and the Byzantine conquest of 1018. Byzantine rule over Bulgaria lasted until the revolt of 1185.

value.zh: 680至681年阿斯帕鲁赫率保加尔人建立。
value.en: Founded in 680-681 by Asparuh and his Bulgars.

value.zh: 864年在鲍里斯一世时期皈依基督教。
value.en: It adopted Christianity under Boris I in 864.

en: The Habsburg monarchy, also called the Habsburg Empire or Habsburg Realm, as the collection of polities ruled by the House of Habsburg
Its renaming as the Austrian Empire from 1804 and as Austria-Hungary from 1867
Its character as a composite monarchy of empires, kingdoms, duchies and counties
zh: 哈布斯堡君主国又称哈布斯堡帝国，是哈布斯堡家族统治的各政体的集合
1804年起称奥地利帝国，1867年起称奥匈帝国
是由帝国、王国、公国与伯国组成的复合君主国

politics.zh: 哈布斯堡君主国又称哈布斯堡帝国或多瑙君主国，是哈布斯堡家族统治的帝国、王国、公国、伯国等政体的集合，属复合君主制。其历史可上溯至13世纪，1526年斐迪南一世取得波希米亚与匈牙利王位后成为中欧多民族大国，1804年起称奥地利帝国，1867年改制为奥匈帝国，1918年第一次世界大战结束时解体。
politics.en: The Habsburg monarchy, also known as the Habsburg Empire, the Habsburg Realm or the Danube Monarchy, was the collection of empires, kingdoms, duchies, counties and other polities ruled by the House of Habsburg as a composite monarchy. Its history reaches back to the thirteenth century, and after Ferdinand I acquired the Bohemian and Hungarian thrones in 1526 it became a multi-national power in central Europe; from 1804 it was called the Austrian Empire and from 1867 Austria-Hungary, dissolving in 1918 at the end of the First World War.

economy.zh: 君主国境内经济差异显著，波希米亚与奥地利的工矿业、匈牙利的农业与多瑙河航运构成互补结构，18世纪起推行重商主义与关税同盟，19世纪铁路与工业在西部加速发展。
economy.en: The monarchy's economy varied greatly by region: industry and mining in Bohemia and Austria complemented agriculture in Hungary and shipping on the Danube, mercantilist policy and a customs union were pursued from the eighteenth century, and in the nineteenth railways and industry expanded rapidly in the west.

culture.zh: 君主国是多种语言与宗教并存的帝国，德语是行政与军队语言，捷克语、匈牙利语、波兰语、意大利语等在各地并用，维也纳在18至19世纪成为欧洲音乐、医学与行政科学的中心。
culture.en: The monarchy was an empire of many languages and religions: German served administration and the army while Czech, Hungarian, Polish, Italian and others were used locally, and Vienna became a centre of European music, medicine and administrative science in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1278年哈布斯堡取得奥地利、1526年取得波希米亚与匈牙利、1683年维也纳解围、1804年称奥地利帝国、1867年奥匈折衷，以及1918年解体。
events.en: Key moments are the Habsburg acquisition of Austria in 1278, of Bohemia and Hungary in 1526, the relief of Vienna in 1683, the proclamation of the Austrian Empire in 1804, the Austro-Hungarian Compromise of 1867 and the dissolution of 1918.

value.zh: 是由多个王国、公国与伯国组成的复合君主国。
value.en: It was a composite monarchy of kingdoms, duchies and counties.

value.zh: 1804年称奥地利帝国，1867年称奥匈帝国。
value.en: It was renamed the Austrian Empire in 1804 and Austria-Hungary in 1867.

en: The Emirate of Cordoba, and from 929 the Caliphate of Cordoba, as an Arab Islamic state ruled by the Umayyad dynasty from 756 to 1031
Its territory comprising most of the Iberian Peninsula, known to Muslims as al-Andalus, the Balearic Islands and parts of North Africa
Its capital at Cordoba and its status as an independent emirate from 756 until Abd al-Rahman III proclaimed the caliphate
zh: 科尔多瓦酋长国及其929年后的科尔多瓦哈里发国是756至1031年由伍麦叶王朝统治的阿拉伯伊斯兰国家
领土包括伊比利亚半岛大部（穆斯林称安达卢斯）、巴利阿里群岛与北非部分地区
首都科尔多瓦，756年起为独立酋长国，后由阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世宣布为哈里发国

politics.zh: 科尔多瓦酋长国是756至1031年间由伍麦叶王朝统治的阿拉伯伊斯兰国家，929年后改称科尔多瓦哈里发国。其领土包括伊比利亚半岛大部（穆斯林称安达卢斯）、巴利阿里群岛与北非部分地区，首都设在科尔多瓦。756年阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼一世在此建立独立酋长国，929年阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世宣布哈里发地位，1031年哈里发国在内部冲突中解体为诸泰法小国。
politics.en: The Emirate of Cordoba, and from 929 the Caliphate of Cordoba, was an Arab Islamic state ruled by the Umayyad dynasty from 756 to 1031. Its territory comprised most of the Iberian Peninsula, known to Muslims as al-Andalus, together with the Balearic Islands and parts of North Africa, and its capital was Cordoba. Abd al-Rahman I established an independent emirate there in 756, Abd al-Rahman III proclaimed the caliphate in 929, and in 1031 the caliphate broke up into the taifa kingdoms amid internal conflict.

economy.zh: 经济以灌溉农业、手工业与地中海贸易为基础，科尔多瓦是西欧最大的城市之一，橄榄、葡萄与柑橘种植发达，纺织品、皮革与纸张制造兴盛，银币第纳尔流通于地中海市场。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming, crafts and Mediterranean trade; Cordoba was one of the largest cities in western Europe, olives, grapes and citrus were widely grown, textiles, leather and paper were manufactured, and the silver dirham circulated in Mediterranean markets.

culture.zh: 科尔多瓦是伊斯兰世界与欧洲文化交流的中心，清真寺、图书馆与翻译活动使希腊、波斯与阿拉伯学术在此汇集，犹太与基督教社群参与学术生活，伊本·鲁世德与迈蒙尼德等思想家出于安达卢斯。
culture.en: Cordoba was a centre of exchange between the Islamic world and Europe: its mosque, libraries and translation activity brought Greek, Persian and Arabic learning together, Jewish and Christian communities took part in scholarly life, and thinkers such as Averroes and Maimonides came from al-Andalus.

events.zh: 关键节点包括756年建立酋长国、929年宣布哈里发国、10世纪后期的内乱与权臣掌权，以及1031年哈里发国解体。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the emirate in 756, the proclamation of the caliphate in 929, the civil strife and rise of the chamberlain in the late tenth century and the break-up of the caliphate in 1031.

value.zh: 首都设在科尔多瓦。
value.en: Its capital was Cordoba.

value.zh: 929年阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世宣布哈里发地位。
value.en: Abd al-Rahman III proclaimed the caliphate in 929.
